title: 第627章 电棍下乡无限制格斗大赛准备中第626章 方桌会议
lines: “所以……你们也要搞无尽能源？”
许平秋这下听懂了，大为震撼，天墟的人才还是太多了。
“哎！这倒不能说是我们。”
李成周认真纠正道：“准确来说，还是钱伟兴和钨铁山那边在捣鼓。你也知道，他们不正在为飞舰解决能源问题吗？核电项目好像弄得七七八八了，但他们不是很满意，就继续折腾起这个来了。”
“还是他们？”
许平秋听到这两个名字，顿时感觉不是很妙妙。
这两货的作风向来讲究一个大胆假设，大胆求证，真要是出了什么岔子，那便是再大胆甩锅。
核电出事还算小逝，焚道真火可是大逝！
一个搞不好，整个天墟只怕都要无痛转生到羽化真道的那什么赤明净梵天里去。
“所以他们有经验嘛。”
李成周倒是很淡定，继续说道：“眼下内阁给他们定了规矩，所有与焚道真火相关的实验，一律得在隔灵区里进行。只要没有灵性介质从中牵引传导，就算一时失控，也很难殃及外头。”
对于安全生产四个字，李成周还是很有发言权的。
否则以丹阁重工那边三天两头就差点出事的节奏，他这个首辅早就和阎王爷私奔了。
“行吧。”
许平秋想了想，觉得自己身为老登，对小登终究还是要有那么一点信任的。
“对了。”李成周像是忽然想起了什么，“电棍下乡你知道吗？”
“什么玩意？”
许平秋感觉这四个字好像有点耳熟，但一时又想不起在哪里听过。
不过光听字面的意思，颇有一种无限制格斗大赛的气息，非常热血！
“你不知道？”
李成周神色变得有几分微妙：“邵长老正在组织一批队伍，准备开赴清镜，说是你授意的。”
许平秋先是微愣了一下，可仔细回想一番，自己好像确实和邵光暮随口说过一句：“记住，对付鸽子，不需要慈悲。”
这话……算授意吗？
好像勉强也算。
但究竟发生了什么，才会让这件事一路发展到要和清镜打成一片的地步？
幸好如今天墟已经全面接入灵境，许平秋念头一动，便在灵境里搜寻起来，很快找到了邵光暮提交给内阁的行动申请。
《关于推动清镜协同项目按期落地的线下督办方案》
为贯彻落实天墟与清镜互通有无、协同共建、资源共享之基本方略，进一步强化跨宗门项目执行力度，现拟组织专项督办队伍，赴清镜开展实地沟通、现场协调与节点推进工作……
该说不说，这公文还蛮正经。
正经到许平秋将其从头到尾全部看完后，依旧没弄明白到底发生了什么，只知道即将要发生什么。
至于这支督鸽队的组建方式，也素朴得很，邵光暮直接把组队邀请挂在了世界频道上。
几乎是转瞬之间，队伍便满员。
那些认真思考组队究竟是干什么的弟子，压根没有抢过那些看见招募人数一百名，就无脑入队的弟子。
毕竟，寻常搬砖根本用不上这么多人手。
而一件事若需要这么多人手，那一定很好玩！
于是，没能抢到名额的天墟弟子，在世界频道上捶胸顿足，悔之不及，明知有大活，偏偏插不上手。
而抢到名额的弟子在阅读完督办方案后，则开始在世界频道上疯狂炫耀自己即将参加清镜大型线下友好交流活动，并纷纷表示，一定会让清镜充分感受到天墟的热情与友好。
就他们这嘴脸，许平秋怎么看，怎么都不是很友好！
他连忙问：“队伍现在在哪儿？”
李成周扫了一眼灵境回执，说道：“器阁，正在集结领装备。”
“还发装备？”

;;
"So...you also want to develop endless energy?"
Xu Pingqiu understood now and was shocked. Tianxu still had too many talents.
"Hey! You can't say it's us."
Li Chengzhou corrected seriously: "To be precise, Qian Weixing and Tungsten Iron Mountain are still tinkering. You also know, aren't they solving the energy problem for the spacecraft? The nuclear power project seems to have been completed, but they are not very satisfied, so they continue to mess with it."
"Or them?"
When Xu Pingqiu heard these two names, he immediately felt uncomfortable.
The style of these two guys has always been about making a bold hypothesis and boldly verifying it. If something really goes wrong, then they will boldly pass the blame.
A nuclear power accident is a small disaster, but the Burning Dao Zhenhuo is a big disaster!
If one person fails, the entire Tianxu may have to be reincarnated painlessly into some kind of red, bright and pure Brahma world where the true way of enlightenment comes.
"So they have experience."
Li Chengzhou was very calm and continued: "At the moment, the cabinet has set rules for them. All experiments related to the Burning Dao True Fire must be conducted in the Spiritual Separation Zone. As long as there is no spiritual medium to guide and transmit it, even if it is temporarily out of control, it will be difficult to cause damage to the outside world."
Regarding the four words of safe production, Li Chengzhou still has a say.
Otherwise, with the pace of things almost happening at Dange Heavy Industries every three days, he, the chief assistant, would have eloped with the Lord of Hell long ago.
"Okay."
Xu Pingqiu thought about it and felt that as Lao Deng, he still had to have some trust in Xiao Deng.
"That's right." Li Chengzhou seemed to suddenly remember something, "Did you know that electric batons were sent to the countryside?"
"What the hell?"
Xu Pingqiu felt that these four words seemed familiar, but he couldn't remember where he had heard them.
But just listening to the literal meaning, it has the atmosphere of an unlimited fighting competition, very passionate!
"You don't know?"
Li Chengzhou's expression became a little subtle: "Elder Shao is organizing a group of teams to go to Qingjing. He said it was your order."
"Huh?"
Xu Pingqiu was stunned for a moment, but after thinking about it carefully, he seemed to have said something casually to Shao Guangmu: "Remember, you don't need mercy when dealing with pigeons."
Is this... an instruction?
It seems that barely counts.
But what exactly happened to make this matter develop all the way to the point of getting involved with Qing Jing?
Fortunately, the ruins have now been fully connected to the spiritual realm. Xu Pingqiu had an idea and searched in the spiritual realm, and soon found the action application submitted by Shao Guangmu to the cabinet.
"Offline Supervision Plan for Promoting the Scheduled Implementation of the Qingjing Collaboration Project"
In order to implement the basic strategy of Tianxu and Qingjing's exchange of needs, collaborative construction, and resource sharing, and further strengthen the execution of cross-sect projects, it is planned to organize a special supervision team to go to Qingjing to carry out on-site communication, on-site coordination and node promotion work...
Say it or not, this official document is quite serious.
It was so serious that after Xu Pingqiu read it from beginning to end, he still didn't understand what happened, he only knew what was about to happen.
As for the formation method of this pigeon team, it was very simple. Shao Guangmu directly posted the invitation to form the team on the World Channel.
Almost instantly, the line was full.
Those disciples who seriously thought about the purpose of forming a team did not overtake those disciples who joined the team without thinking when they saw a hundred recruits.
After all, ordinary brick moving does not require so many people.
And if something requires so many people, it must be fun!
Therefore, the Tianxu disciples who failed to grab a spot were beating their chests and feet on the World Channel, regretting that they knew there was a big job but couldn't get involved.
After reading the supervision plan, the disciples who grabbed the quota began to show off on the World Channel that they were about to participate in Qingjing's large-scale offline friendly exchange activities, and they all said that they would definitely let Qingjing fully feel the enthusiasm and friendliness of Tianxu.
With their faces, no matter how Xu Pingqiu looked at them, they were not very friendly!
He quickly asked: "Where is the team now?"
Li Chengzhou glanced at the spiritual realm receipt and said: "Qi Pavilion, we are gathering to collect equipment."
"Are you still giving out equipment?"
